pages.text: Apply a small projectile-damage hit to selected non-living entities to trigger their hit behavior. Living entities are ignored.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: 512.5 per non-living target, the ordinary one-damage quote.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1, regardless of damage, effect level or number of targets.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: Using This Node
pages.text: No more nodes or values are needed here. Insert the gem in its matching slot. Right-click it on the canvas when you want to replace it.
